text:
maria: Heads-up — NodeAI wants to run a custom 34B variant (node-34f) for a 2-week POC starting next week. They plan Dedicated for the POC and Private later. Need quick catalog fit + compatibility notes, KMS/HIPAA answers, and a POC pricing sketch. @josh can you do a compatibility pass?
josh: Sure. Quick Qs: what format is the artifact (gguf/pt/ckpt), tokenizer type, max seq len, and did they already quantize? Also need sample prompt distribution (avg tokens / max).
simon-nodeai: Thanks — we uploaded artifacts to s3://nodeai-models/node-34f.gguf. Tokenizer: SentencePiece (v0.1.96) with custom merges. Max input ~8k tokens but typical is 512-1024. We tried 4-bit quant (q4_0) locally; open to testing q5_kv. Model exports as GGUF with kv-friendly layout.
josh: OK GGUF is good. Main things to validate: tokenizer byte-pair compatibility (we've seen custom sp models break padding), KV cache layout (must support continuous-batching), and attention kernel compatibility for long sequences. I'll run a quick dry-load on dev infra. Can you confirm the exact gguf header and any nonstandard metadata?
simon-nodeai: Header shows custom "tokenizer_spec" and a nonstandard "pos_emb" flag — we can strip those if needed. I can share the exact manifest.
josh: Perfect. Plan: 1) dry-load on dev runtime (check loader + tokenizer) 2) run single-GPU inference with q4_0 and q5_kv 3) stress test prefix caching for 1024/4096 windows, measure latencies. ETA ~24-36h.
anika: A few security items from our side: do they expect to send PHI? If yes need HIPAA BA or Private deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM. We support AWS KMS and Vault HSM integration; for on-prem we need install window. Also need them to fill the security questionnaire (I can DM link).
simon-nodeai: We're not sending PHI in the POC, but full product will have PHI later. For now, want encryption at rest + in transit. They prefer using their AWS KMS key.
anika: Fine for POC if they use AWS KMS and sign an addendum. For Private/Prod we'll require audit config and SOC2 attestation copy. I'll send the questionnaire and SSO setup checklist.
leo: Infra notes: given gguf + q4_0, memory footprint per 34B on 4-bit ~30-40GB VRAM but KV cache for 8k windows pushes working set up. For stable latency at 8k we recommend A100 80GB or 2xH100-80 multi-GPU sharded runtime. For a POC with typical 512-1k tokens, a single A100-80 should be fine. Estimated Dedicated baseline: $28/hr for a single A100-80 instance (list internal estimate), with autoscale overhead. Monthly reserved estimate for production (3x replicas) ~ $60k/mo. For POC we can provide $2k credit and discounted reserved price if they convert within 90 days.
kevin: From AE side — propose 2-week POC: include 1x A100-80 dedicated pool, 100k generated tokens included, integration support (SE hours), and KMS hookup. Proposed POC fee: $3,500 (covers support/priority infra + 25% usage buffer). If they commit to Dedicated annual reservation we can apply $10k credit.
maria: Sounds good. I'll send Simon the POC statement + SOW. @josh prioritize compatibility checks so we can confirm pricing numbers.
josh: Starting dry-load now. Quick instructions for preflight if the customer wants to try themselves:
```bash
# upload via rwictl (customer CLI)
rwictl model upload --name node-34f --format gguf --quant q4_0 --source s3://nodeai-models/node-34f.gguf
# or run quick loader test
rwictl model test-loader --name node-34f --tokenizer "s3://nodeai-models/tokenizer.json" --max-tokens 1024
```
simon-nodeai: Thanks — I'll kick off the upload and DM the manifest. Also can you confirm whether fallback to our smaller variant (node-13b) is automatically allowed if memory constraints hit? We'd like graceful degradation rather than failing requests.
josh: We support fallback routing. We can wire policy: prefer node-34f, fallback to node-13f-lite (compatible checkpoint) with latency-based route. We'll test fallback behavior in the POC.
anika: One more on compliance: please add "no-logs" opt-in flag for POC if they want ephemeral traces disabled. We'll need a signed config change for logging retention.
kevin: I'll include the no-logs clause in the POC SOW.
maria: Great. Scheduling a technical sync with NodeAI tomorrow 10am PT — I'll send calendar invite. @deploy-bot can you drop the onboarding doc link? :slightly_smiling_face:
deploy-bot: onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/docs/poc-onboarding — includes model upload, KMS setup, and SE contact list.
maria: Thanks all — moving to action items: josh will post compatibility results here (ETA 36h), anika to send questionnaire, kevin to draft SOW, simon to share manifest + start upload.
simon-nodeai: Upload started, manifest coming now. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
